description: ACKS 1e reusable power definitions. Metadata only - progression tables live on class JSONs.

powers.description: Pick mechanical locks using thieves' tools. Throw d20 vs target; success on meeting or exceeding target.
powers.notes: Requires thieves' tools. One attempt per lock per level gained.

powers.description: Detect and disarm mechanical traps. Throw d20 vs target; success on meeting or exceeding target.
powers.notes: Requires thieves' tools for removal. Detection is visual/tactile search.

powers.description: Lift small objects from a target without detection. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Failure by 4+ means target notices. Also covers sleight of hand.

powers.description: Move without making audible noise. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Checked once per movement through an area with potential listeners.

powers.description: Scale sheer surfaces without climbing gear. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Check per 100 feet climbed. Failure means fall from halfway point.

powers.description: Remain unseen while in dim lighting or shadows. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Cannot hide while being directly observed. Must remain motionless.

powers.description: Detect faint sounds through doors or around corners. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Requires 1 round of quiet listening. Party must be silent.

powers.description: Attack an unaware opponent from behind for multiplied damage. +4 to attack throw; damage multiplied by progression value.
powers.notes: Requires surprise or successful hide/move silently. Multiplier increases with level.

powers.description: Bonus to melee and missile damage from martial training. Added to all successful attack damage rolls.
powers.notes: Applies to both melee and missile attacks. Stacks with STR/DEX modifiers.

powers.description: When a fighter-type kills or incapacitates an enemy in melee, may immediately make another attack throw against another enemy within 5 feet.
powers.notes: Number of cleaves per round equals character level. All fighter-progression classes get this.

powers.description: Channel divine power to drive away or destroy undead creatures. Roll 2d6 and compare to target by undead HD category.
powers.notes: T = automatically turned. D = automatically destroyed. Number affected = 2d6 HD of undead.

powers.description: Channel dark power to command undead creatures rather than turning them. Uses same table as Turn Undead but controls rather than repels.
powers.notes: Anti-Paladin variant. Controlled undead serve the caster.

powers.description: Cast divine spells granted by deity or spiritual tradition. Spell slots per level determined by class progression.
powers.notes: Spells must be selected from class spell list. Can cast in any armor.

powers.description: Cast arcane spells from a learned repertoire. Spell slots per level determined by class progression.
powers.notes: Spells must be in repertoire. Cannot cast in armor unless class specifically allows it.

powers.description: Cast arcane spells while wearing armor. Elven classes and certain hybrid classes can cast arcane spells without armor restriction.
powers.notes: Replaces standard arcane_casting for classes that permit armored casting.

powers.description: Decipher unknown written languages and coded messages. Throw d20 vs target to comprehend a text.
powers.notes: Does not grant ability to speak the language. One check per document.

powers.description: Cast spells from arcane scrolls despite not being a mage. Throw d20 vs target; failure causes mishap.
powers.notes: Failure results may include reversed spell or explosion.

powers.description: Use wands, staffs, and other magic items normally restricted to arcane casters. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Failure may cause item backfire. Bard class ability.

powers.description: Recall ancient history, identify artifacts, and decipher occult runes. Throw d20 vs target.
powers.notes: Broader than sage knowledge. Covers legends, artifacts, and magical lore.

powers.description: Perform music, poetry, or oration to inspire allies or influence audiences. Choose one performance type at 1st level.
powers.notes: Additional performance types via Perform proficiency.

powers.description: +1 bonus to morale rolls for henchmen and mercenaries under the character's command.
powers.notes: Applies when the character is personally present and commanding.

powers.description: Build a castle and attract followers. Becomes a landed lord with domain management abilities.
powers.notes: Fighter class. Attracts peasants and militia.

powers.description: Build a sanctum tower. Attracts 1d6 apprentices (1st-3rd level mages) and 2d6 normal-man seekers.
powers.notes: Mage class. Apprentices serve without pay.

powers.description: Build a fortified church. Attracts 5d6x10 0-level soldiers and 1d6 clerics (1st-3rd level). All serve for free.
powers.notes: Cleric class. +4 morale bonus to followers.

powers.description: Establish a hideout in a settlement. Attracts 2d6 1st-level thief apprentices, paid as ruffians.
powers.notes: Thief class.

powers.description: Establish an underground vault. Attracts 3d6x10 1st-level dwarven NPCs.
powers.notes: Dwarven Vaultguard class.

powers.description: Establish a fastness in a natural setting. Attracts 3d6x10 elven NPCs.
powers.notes: Elven classes.

powers.description: Establish a merchant guildhouse. Attracts 2d6 1st-level venturer apprentices.
powers.notes: Venturer class.

powers.description: Research new spells, create new spell formulas. Available at 5th level for arcane casters, 5th level for divine.
powers.notes: Requires time, gold, and access to library/workshop.

powers.description: Create spell scrolls from known spells. Available at 5th level.
powers.notes: Requires appropriate materials and time.

powers.description: Brew magical potions. Available at 5th level for casters.
powers.notes: Requires ingredients, formula, and time.

powers.description: Create major magic items (weapons, armor, rings, etc.). Available at 9th level.
powers.notes: Requires rare materials, high gold cost, extended time.

powers.description: See heat signatures in darkness out to 60 feet. Cannot distinguish color or read text.
powers.notes: Dwarven and some elven racial ability.

powers.description: Heightened ability to notice hidden doors and passages. Active search: 8+ on d6. Passive (walking past): 14+ on d6.
powers.notes: Elven racial ability. Active search takes 1 turn.

powers.description: Detect traps, sliding walls, sloping corridors, and new construction in stonework. 14+ proficiency throw when actively searching.
powers.notes: Dwarven racial ability.

powers.description: Immune to the paralysis attack of ghouls.
powers.notes: Elven racial ability.

powers.description: Enhanced saving throws due to dwarven constitution. Saving throw bonuses: -3 vs Blast/Breath, -4 vs all other categories.
powers.notes: Already factored into dwarven class saving throw tables. Do not double-apply.

powers.description: +1 bonus on surprise rolls when underground.
powers.notes: Dwarven racial ability.

powers.description: +1 bonus on surprise rolls in wilderness settings.
powers.notes: Elven racial ability.

powers.description: -1 bonus (improvement) to saving throws vs Petrification/Paralysis and Spells.
powers.notes: Already factored into elven class saving throw tables. Do not double-apply.

powers.description: Tumble behind an opponent to negate shield AC bonus and enable backstab. Base throw 20+, improves by 1 per level.
powers.notes: Elven Nightblade class ability. Target loses shield bonus to AC.

powers.description: Heal 2 hit points per class level by touch, once per day.
powers.notes: Paladin class ability.

powers.description: Sense evil creatures, enchantments, or intentions within range by concentrating for one round.
powers.notes: Paladin class ability. Range typically 60 feet.

powers.description: Sense good creatures, enchantments, or intentions within range by concentrating for one round.
powers.notes: Anti-Paladin class ability. Mirror of Detect Evil.

powers.description: Radiate a protective aura that provides bonuses to nearby allies and penalties to opposing forces.
powers.notes: Paladin (vs evil) and Anti-Paladin (vs good) class ability.

powers.description: Immune to all forms of disease, including magical diseases.
powers.notes: Paladin class ability.

powers.description: +1 morale to same-faith hirelings and henchmen at 5th level.
powers.notes: Paladin / Anti-Paladin (unholy fanaticism) class ability.

powers.description: Treat markets visited as one class larger. Grants mercantile advantages in trade.
powers.notes: Venturer class ability.

powers.description: 10% discount when buying, +10% when selling goods. Can compete with other bargainers via reaction rolls.
powers.notes: Venturer class ability.

powers.description: +2 to reaction rolls when parlaying with intelligent creatures.
powers.notes: Venturer class ability. Separate from CHA modifier.

powers.description: Gather 1d4 rumors from old contacts when revisiting a settlement. Takes 6 hours, once per month per settlement.
powers.notes: Venturer class ability, available at 4th level.

powers.description: Borrow from merchant guilds at favorable rates. 3% monthly without collateral, 1% with collateral.
powers.notes: Venturer class ability, available at 8th level.

powers.description: Craft goods worth 20gp/month, supervise 3 apprentices, identify masterwork items (8+ throw), +3 to craft proficiencies.
powers.notes: Dwarven Craftpriest class ability.

powers.description: Through performance, grant allies +1 to attack throws, damage rolls, morale, and saving throws vs fear for the duration.
powers.notes: Bard and Elven Courtier class ability.

powers.description: +1 bonus to either melee or missile attack throws (chosen at 1st level).
powers.notes: Elven Courtier class ability.

powers.description: +2 bonus to saving throws where physical agility would help (e.g., dodging, tumbling).
powers.notes: Elven Nightblade class ability.
